name: Geo Energy Resources Limited
summary: Geo Energy Resources Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the mining, production, and trading of coal. The company operates through three segments: Coal Mining, Coal Trading, and Mining Services. The Coal Mining segment engages in the production and sale of coal. The Coal Trading segment is involved in the purchase and sale of coal from third parties. The Mining Services segment provides mining contracting and project management services for mining activities conducted at third party mines.
